[DQC.US.0249.10961] The filing has reported a value for the element us-gaap:CostOfRevenue with a value of 1,700,000 using the axis ContractWithCustomerBasisOfPricingAxis in the role 999083 - Disclosure - REVENUE FROM CONTRACTS WITH CUSTOMERS (Details Narrative) on the table NIMU:RevenueFromContractsWithCustomersTable. However, the only member used to disaggregate the total for us-gaap:CostOfRevenue was the member us-gaap:FixedPriceContractMember. If only one member is used on this axis then the filer should either:
1. Retag the filing using the element RevenueFromContractWithCustomerBasisOfPricingExtensibleList with a value of us-gaap:FixedPriceContractMember. The member us-gaap:FixedPriceContractMember should be removed from the value as it represents the aggregate value of us-gaap:CostOfRevenue.
2. Tag the aggregate value of us-gaap:CostOfRevenue with a value of 1,700,000 without the ContractWithCustomerBasisOfPricingAxis axis. This rule will not generate an error if the aggregate value of us-gaap:CostOfRevenue is reported.
The properties of this us-gaap:CostOfRevenue fact are: Period :2024-03-25 to 2024-03-25 Dimensions : us-gaap:ContractWithCustomerBasisOfPricingAxis=us-gaap:FixedPriceContractMember, srt:ConsolidatedEntitiesAxis=NIMU:GraviticsIncMember, dei:LegalEntityAxis=NIMU:USAirForceResearchLaboratoryMember Unit : USD
Rule Element Id:10961 Rule version: 31.0.1 - forms-4a.htm 24
